name: JAAD two-stage early/late XGBoost transfer and native training

excluded: ego speed because JAAD has no equivalent annotation

arms.two_stage: 161-D frames-1--8 representation -> 125-tree XGBoost -> provisional probability; 182-D full-window representation plus provisional probability -> 125-tree XGBoost

evaluations.zero_shot: train both arms on the exact PIE Exp076 training cohort without ego; freeze; evaluate once on JAAD test without adaptation, calibration, or threshold selection
evaluations.jaad_native: train both arms on JAAD train; report validation; evaluate both frozen arms once on JAAD test

discipline.jaad_test_limitation: JAAD test has prior exposure in separate experiments; Exp077 decisions were frozen before this evaluation
